description.value: A Parks Canada frontcountry campground sitting in the heart of Rogers Pass within Glacier National Park, with easy Trans-Canada Highway access and dramatic glaciated peaks all around; bear-country food protocols are strictly enforced and the site is summer-only at this elevation.

address.value: Illecillewaet Campground, Glacier, BC V0E 2S0, Canada

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Parks Canada website confirms Illecillewaet Campground exists within Glacier National Park with trailer and tent sites. The website explicitly states reservations are accepted at Illecillewaet Campground, though the campground table description says 'First come, first serve' — both may be true (mixed reservable/FCFS). The website confirms bear-proof food lockers are available at campgrounds. No evidence was found for hiker/biker sites, showers, potable water, laundry, or other specific amenities.
